episodes.synopsis: Traveling through the heavy mountain fog, Sachin, Reenu, and Amal face an eerie presence when their car sputters to a halt.
episodes.cliffhanger: A freezing handprint slowly presses against the outer window glass from the dark outside.

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Sachin peers through the misty passenger-side window in astonishment, noticing the woman disappearing into the thick fog while Amal navigates the car forward.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D medium close-up focused on Sachin looking out window

shots.speaker: Amal

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Amal twists the car ignition key frantically in the driver's seat as the vehicle shudders, the dashboard lights flicker, and the engine sputters dead on the dark mountain road.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ചെക്കാ, നമ്മുടെ വണ്ടി ഇപ്പോൾ പണി തന്നു!
shots.camera_hint: Dramatic 3D medium close-up of Amal turning ignition key with worried look

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Sachin unbuckles his seatbelt in the front passenger seat and prepares to crack open the passenger door into the biting mountain cold to inspect the car bonnet.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: നീ പേടിക്കാതെടാ, ഞാൻ ബോണറ്റ് തുറന്ന് നോക്കാം.

shots.speaker: Reenu

shots.camera_hint: Expressive 3D close-up of Reenu leaning between front seats in dread

shots.speaker: Amal

shots.camera_hint: Dynamic 3D medium close-up of Amal snapping lock down

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Sachin pulls his travel jacket tight against the freezing monsoon mountain gust blowing through the cracked window glass, breath misting in the cold air.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up of Sachin shivering by passenger window

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Amal recoils in terror in the driver's seat, staring wide-eyed into the illuminated side rearview mirror where an eerie shadowy silhouette looms close.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: എന്റെ അമ്മോ, ആ കണ്ണാടിയിൽ എന്തോ നിഴലിക്കുന്നു!
shots.camera_hint: Over-the-shoulder 3D shot past Amal looking into mirror reflection

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Sachin quickly pulls his legs back inside the passenger seat, slams the door shut, and urgently turns to Amal in the driver seat, yelling to start the engine.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഡോർ ലോക്ക് ആയില്ലേ അമൽ, വേഗം വണ്ടി സ്റ്റാർട്ട് ചെയ്യ്!

FACT_LOCKED_ROOM_WARNING.name: Warning About Room 13
FACT_LOCKED_ROOM_WARNING.description: Sreedharan strictly warns them never to open or enter Room 13 at the end of the hallway.

FACT_VINTAGE_PHOTO_CLUE.name: Discovery of the Three-Person Photograph
FACT_VINTAGE_PHOTO_CLUE.description: Inside Room 13, Amal discovers an eerie vintage photograph depicting three people instead of two.

FACT_ABANDONED_FACTORY_TREK.name: Trek into the Tea Plantation and Old Factory
FACT_ABANDONED_FACTORY_TREK.description: During a morning walk in the tea plantation, they enter an abandoned British-era tea factory.

FACT_NOTEBOOK_DRAWING_FOUND.name: Bhadra's Notebook and Sketch
FACT_NOTEBOOK_DRAWING_FOUND.description: Reenu and Sachin discover an old notebook in the factory containing a sketch matching the woman on the road.

FACT_WARNING_NOTE_DISCOVERED.name: Warning Note to Avoid the Bridge
FACT_WARNING_NOTE_DISCOVERED.description: Reenu discovers an anonymous note slipped inside the homestay warning: 'Do not go to the old bridge'.

FACT_BHADRA_LOCKET_FOUND.name: Discovery of the Antique Locket
FACT_BHADRA_LOCKET_FOUND.description: At the forbidden dilapidated bridge, Reenu recovers an antique silver locket belonging to Bhadra.

FACT_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.name: Old Bridge Collapses
FACT_BRIDGE_COLLAPSE.description: A structural crash in the dense forest destroys the old bridge walkway, cutting off that route.

FACT_TORN_BETRAYAL_LETTER.name: Uncovering the Betrayal Letter
FACT_TORN_BETRAYAL_LETTER.description: In an estate shed, Sachin and Reenu find newspaper clippings and a letter proving Bhadra was deliberately betrayed.

FACT_CARETAKER_CONFESSION.name: Caretaker Sreedharan's Confession
FACT_CARETAKER_CONFESSION.description: Confronted with the letter, Sreedharan confesses he kept the truth hidden and warns Bhadra's spirit returns tonight.

FACT_FINALE_EVIDENCE_RECOVERY.name: Final Clue Recovered from Collapsing Factory
FACT_FINALE_EVIDENCE_RECOVERY.description: Sachin recovers the hidden compartment in the factory bringing justice to Bhadra before the building collapses.

FACT_FINALE_PHOTO_PEACE_REVEAL.name: The Ghost in the Photo Smiles in Peace
FACT_FINALE_PHOTO_PEACE_REVEAL.description: In the departing car, Sachin and Amal look at the vintage photo and see Bhadra's spirit smiling in peaceful release.

episodes.central_objective: Survive the engine breakdown and mysterious presence on foggy Gap Road.

shots.speaker: Sachin

shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D medium close-up focused on Sachin looking out window

shots.speaker: Amal

shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D medium shot focused on Amal in driver seat

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Amal twists the car ignition key frantically in the driver's seat as the vehicle shudders, the dashboard lights flicker, and the engine sputters dead on the dark mountain road.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ചെക്കാ, നമ്മുടെ വണ്ടി ഇപ്പോൾ പണി തന്നു!
shots.camera_hint: Dramatic 3D medium close-up of Amal turning ignition key with worried look

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Sachin unbuckles his seatbelt in the front passenger seat and prepares to crack open the passenger door into the biting mountain cold to inspect the car bonnet.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: നീ പേടിക്കാതെടാ, ഞാൻ ബോണറ്റ് തുറന്ന് നോക്കാം.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D medium shot of Sachin unbuckling in passenger seat

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Reenu leans forward anxiously from the rear seat, clutching the front headrest in dread, warning Sachin not to leave the vehicle as dark shadows drift outside.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: സച്ചിൻ, പുറത്തിറങ്ങരുത്... ആരോ നമ്മുടെ കാറിനെ പിന്തുടരുന്നുണ്ട്!
shots.camera_hint: Expressive 3D close-up of Reenu leaning between front seats in dread

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Amal urgently snaps the driver-side door lock down and frantically gestures for Sachin and Reenu to secure all doors as fear grips the cabin.
shots.camera_hint: Dynamic 3D medium close-up of Amal snapping lock down

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Sachin pulls his travel jacket tight against the freezing monsoon mountain gust blowing through the cracked window glass, breath misting in the cold air.
shots.camera_hint: Cinematic 3D close-up of Sachin shivering by passenger window

shots.speaker: Amal
shots.action: Amal recoils in terror in the driver's seat, staring wide-eyed into the illuminated side rearview mirror where an eerie shadowy silhouette looms close.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: എന്റെ അമ്മോ, ആ കണ്ണാടിയിൽ എന്തോ നിഴലിക്കുന്നു!
shots.camera_hint: Over-the-shoulder 3D shot past Amal looking into mirror reflection

shots.speaker: Sachin
shots.action: Sachin quickly pulls his legs back inside the passenger seat, slams the door shut, and urgently turns to Amal in the driver seat, yelling to start the engine.
shots.dialogue_malayalam: ഡോർ ലോക്ക് ആയില്ലേ അമൽ, വേഗം വണ്ടി സ്റ്റാർട്ട് ചെയ്യ്!
shots.camera_hint: Tense two-shot of Sachin turning frantically to Amal in driver seat

shots.speaker: Reenu
shots.action: Reenu freezes in pure shock and horror in the rear seat, pointing trembling fingers at a freezing translucent handprint slowly appearing on the condensation of the outer window glass from the blackness outside.
shots.camera_hint: Chilling 3D close-up of Reenu's terrified face with glowing handprint on glass
